text:
Amid arms, war, fire, anger, and fury,
which hold the haughty Frenchman captive,
when the air is darkest and thickest,
there the fierce ardor of love grips me.

I look at the sky, the trees, the flowers,
and in them I find my pain expressed;
in the coldest and most bitter season
my fears are born and green again.

I say through tears: “Oh, sweet spring,
when will I see my hope
bring some peace to my soul?”

But I fear my cruel fate means my end
must lie so far from my beloved
amid war and fury, anger, arms, and fire.

translation.title: Entre armas, guerra, fuego, ira y furores
